title: The capability matrix: what training on one family does to every other
design_ref: The capability matrix: transfer and interference
purpose: Train from the same start on an equal mixture, three times with different seeds (the noise), and on the same mixture with one family boosted by 20 points of weight, twice for each of the six families. The difference of scores is the transfer matrix; cells inside the noise band are shown grey.

steps.display: kubectl apply -f transfer-matrix-s03.yaml   # an Indexed Job on the research queue: 15 cells, 4 at a time

steps.output:
NAME                  STATUS     COMPLETIONS   DURATION   AGE
transfer-matrix-s03   Complete   15/15         52m        52m

steps.display: python transfer_matrix.py transfer-matrix-s03   # rows: the family boosted by 20 points of mixture weight; columns: the family evaluated; * = outside the noise band
python matrix_summary.py   # what the matrix says, in words
steps.output:
diagonal (direct effect): math +0.040, code +0.088, instr +0.048, tools +0.027, multiling +0.006, safety +0.078
off-diagonal cells inside the noise band: 19 of 30
transfer outside the noise band: instr->multiling +0.008; tools->multiling +0.016; multiling->math +0.036; safety->math +0.029
interference outside the noise band: math->instr -0.067; math->multiling -0.010; code->instr -0.037; instr->code -0.098; tools->code -0.084; multiling->instr -0.049; safety->multiling -0.007
asymmetric pairs (A helps B by more than B helps A): 7

checks.because: Three baseline seeds and six boosts with two seeds each, as one Indexed Job on the research queue.

checks.description: raising a family's weight raises its own held-out score in at least five of six families (the diagonal)
checks.because: The direct effect is large by design: twenty more points of a family's share is that many more of its prompts in the batch, and the verifiers reward exactly what the held-out set measures.

checks.description: most apparent transfer is inside the seed noise: at least half of the off-diagonal cells are not outside the band
checks.because: The design's own warning: many apparent transfer effects are smaller than the variation between seeds, and the matrix is shown with those cells grey so that nobody argues from them. The band is twice the standard error of a difference of two means, with the noise taken from three baseline seeds.

checks.description: the matrix is directional: it is not symmetric (at least one pair differs by more than twice the noise between its two directions, or is significant in only one)
checks.because: 'A helps B' does not mean 'B helps A': the families share different skills in different directions, and the matrix keeps rows (added) and columns (evaluated) apart.

checks.description: the new family's column was measured for free: the seventh family (sorting) has a baseline score and a noise estimate before it is admitted (S09)
checks.because: Every run evaluates the seventh family without training on it. The admission test of S09 then has its before-and-after for the existing families' effect on the newcomer.
